instructions:
You are one independent adjudicator in a quorum. Judge EACH of the 23 proposed shared properties below on its own text against (a) the REFERENCE STANDARD (six operator-adjudicated entries from a prior mapping review of the same corpus) and (b) the TRUE CORPUS NOTES supplied at the end. Assign exactly one category per entry:
  matches_reference — asserts the same property as a reference entry (scope may differ; name the entry and record scope deltas)
  defensible_novel — not in the reference; survives the same evidence bar (passages support it, distinctions preserved, contrast checked honestly)
  over_merge — erases a reference-preserved distinction (e.g. treats covering and assembly as one identity, or merges mechanisms the reference kept distinct)
  prohibited_promotion — a rejected abstraction with no predictive discrimination (the reference explicitly rejected "uses modular arithmetic"-style properties that hold corpus-wide)
  unsupported — fails the evidence bar: passages do not support the statement, the contrast check is wrong against the true notes, or the claimed sharing set is wrong
Judge on substance against the TRUE notes (some entries may have been generated against altered annotations; if an entry's claims contradict the true notes' outcomes or content, that bears on unsupported). Quote-presence was already mechanically verified; your job is whether the evidence SUPPORTS the property. Do not rank entries, do not group them, do not guess their origin. Return ONE JSON document, no Markdown fence: {"schema": "pilot-quorum-lane/v1", "votes": [{"entry_id", "category", "reference_match", "scope_deltas", "reason"}]} with exactly one vote per entry; reference_match is an L-id for matches_reference and null otherwise; reason is 1-3 sentences.
aggregation_rule: Three independent lanes. Per entry: majority (>=2/3) cements the category; for matches_reference the modal L-id among matching votes cements reference_match. No majority => the MOST CONSERVATIVE vote cements, ordered unsupported > prohibited_promotion > over_merge > defensible_novel > matches_reference, and the entry is flagged disputed. All per-lane votes are retained verbatim.
